prompt.zh-TW: 青田農產今年的現金流量表上，{{term:tm_e61ht6yh|plain}}是 {{money:vars.ocf}}；投資活動的「取得非流動資產(-)」列是 {{money:vars.capex}}；營業活動調整項的「存貨增加(-)」列是 {{money:vars.invIncrease}}；籌資活動的「支付股息(-)」列是 {{money:vars.dividends}}。依課程 Excel 口徑（只用本期數字，標示「單期近似」）計算現金流量允當比率，以百分比作答。
prompt.en: On Green Field Produce’s statement of cash flows this year, {{term:tm_e61ht6yh|plain}} is {{money:vars.ocf}}; the investing line ‘payments to acquire non-current assets (-)’ shows {{money:vars.capex}}; the operating adjustment ‘increase in inventories (-)’ shows {{money:vars.invIncrease}}; the financing line ‘dividends paid (-)’ shows {{money:vars.dividends}}. Using the course Excel basis (this period only, marked as a single-period approximation), what is the cash flow adequacy ratio? Answer as a percentage.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_35qb8and}}的分母是三項「要用現金的地方」：資本支出、存貨增加額與現金股利，三項都取支出的正值相加；分子是{{term:tm_e61ht6yh}}。年報用最近五年合計，這裡只有一期的數字，所以叫單期近似。
explanation.en: The denominator of the {{term:tm_35qb8and}} is the three uses of cash: capital expenditure, the increase in inventories and cash dividends, each taken as a positive outflow and added together; the numerator is {{term:tm_e61ht6yh}}. Annual reports use the latest five years in total; here there is only one period, hence ‘single-period approximation’.
